integrity: The universal statement is proved representation-theoretically. The finite computation is corroborative only and is not used as a substitute for the proof.
scientific_limitations: Requires a finite symmetric rank-three action; no higher-rank or nonsymmetric-rank-three analogue is claimed. An equivalent identity under association-scheme or spherical-function terminology remains a residual literature risk.
title: Exact Fourier-algebra norm from induced edges in symmetric rank-three actions
